question.prompt: Pauline Bunyan can shovel snow at the rate of \(20\) cubic yards for the first hour, \(19\) cubic yards for the second, \(18\) for the third, etc., always shoveling one cubic yard less per hour than the previous hour. If her driveway is \(4\) yards wide, \(10\) yards long, and covered with snow \(3\) yards deep, then the number of hours it will take her to shovel it clean is closest to

solutions.explanation:
First find the amount of snow to remove. It forms a rectangular prism with volume
\[
4\times10\times3=120\text{ cubic yards}.
\]
Her hourly amounts decrease by \(1\), so in the first seven hours she removes
\[
20+19+18+17+16+15+14=119
\]
cubic yards. There is still \(120-119=1\) cubic yard left.

During the eighth hour, her rate is \(13\) cubic yards per hour. At that rate, removing the remaining cubic yard takes \(\frac1{13}\) hour, making the total time
\[
7+\frac1{13}\text{ hours}.
\]
Since \(\frac1{13}<\frac12\), this time lies between \(7\) and \(7.5\) hours. The closest choice is therefore \(\boxed{7\text{ hours}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
solutions.title: Total the snow removed hour by hour
